units.source_text: 他想：“那个细草似的女孩，长大起来一定非常可爱。

en.t: He thought, "That slender, grasslike little girl will surely be very lovely when she grows up.

units.source_text: 但老尼姑以为年龄不称，也是有理之言。

en.t: But the old nun was right to think that the difference in their ages was unsuitable.

units.source_text: 现在要向她求爱，倒是一件难事。

en.t: To court her now would, after all, be a difficult matter.

units.source_text: 我总得想个法子，轻松愉快地将她迎接到这里来看着她，可以朝朝暮暮安慰我心。

en.t: I must find some way to bring her here gently and happily, so that I may watch over her and comfort my heart morning and evening.

units.source_text: 她的父亲兵部卿亲王，品貌的确高尚优美。

en.t: Her father, Prince Hyobukyo, is indeed noble and graceful in both bearing and appearance.
Yet he has no look of radiant beauty.

units.source_text: 何以此人生得如此艳丽，使人一望而知其为藤壶妃子的同族呢？

en.t: Why was this person born with such radiant beauty that one can see at a glance she is of the same family as Lady Fujitsubo?

units.source_text: 想是同一母后血统之故吧？”

en.t: It must be because she comes from the same maternal imperial bloodline."

units.source_text: 因有此缘，更觉恋恋不舍，便呕心沥血地考虑办法。

en.t: Because of this connection, he felt still more attached and unwilling to let her go, and he strained his heart and mind to think of a way.
